purpose: Make proof, review independence, runtime connectivity, authority scoping, and reality reconciliation harder to fake while preserving zero external-effect authority.
hardeningLaws: critical gate artifacts require observed non-synthetic Proof DAG evidence
review execution instances are isolated from build and pairwise distinct
adjacent phase proofs carry ancestry when both phases expose proof nodes
adjacent runtime layers share explicit contracts
authority leases bind exact mission, exact actions, time bounds, revocation state, and evidence
observed effect mismatch triggers stop/reconcile/rollback semantics
truthBoundary: Internal hardening is not external proof. This artifact does not prove alpha, profit, customer acceptance, cleared payment, legal clearance, provider acceptance, life outcomes, or ASI.
